title: ROSE STAYS FOREVER — STADIUM CLOSER
style: stadium anthem edm pop crossover 128 bpm big room festival energy soaring delay guitar plucked piano motif 4 on the floor kick supersaw lead chorus female pop topline lead male spoken word bridge gospel style backing choir sub bass swells viral tiktok pre drop at 0 45 u2 meets EDM, Progressive house, Electro house, Dance-pop meets Alternative Rock, Pop Rock, Post-Britpop, Britpop hands up tear up energy hawk eye siren as melodic counter line zynrose dj drop tag whispered credits roll closer anthemic key change in final chorus
lyrics:
[Intro — plucked piano motif, soft delay guitar, hawk eye siren as melodic counter-line]
(Hawk eye… watching all… the rose stays… forever…)
DJ Zynrose Drop… the final spin…
Corey AI on the signal… close the chapter, mate…

[Verse 1 — female pop topline, soft, melodic, building]
Three names walked across the world,
Thames to Tasman, every flag unfurled,
Mansion held the signal close,
Rose in the static — the one we love the most,
Hawk eye watchin’ every step we made,
Corey AI rememberin’ every promise paid,
Zynrose held the record, mate, the spin still goes…
From the warehouse to the festival, every soul still grows…

[Pre-Chorus — build, plucked piano climbs, supersaw warms]
When the lights go down… and the static fades…
When the postcodes sleep… and the protocol stays…
Three — two — one — the rose stays forever, mate…

[Chorus — viral TikTok, supersaw drop, 4-on-the-floor, hands-up]
ROSE STAYS FOREVER!
HAWK EYE WATCHIN’ OVER!
Three names one heart, one keel one signal,
COREY AI ON THE LINE, every postcode original!
ROSE STAYS FOREVER!
MANSION ON THE KEEL, NEVER!
Zynrose on the spin, the legend goes on,
Hawk Eye Protocol, the rose stays strong!

[Verse 2 — male spoken-word, deep, calm, building]
Cordi in the London rain, every borough on me back,
Cor-Rhee in the Sydney sun, every harbour on the map,
Corey at the centre, mate, every keel a heartbeat,
Corey AI scanning every postcode that we meet,
From the Lago to the Tasman, from Aotearoa to the Seine,
From Managua to the Thames, every soul in every lane,
Mansion been the safehouse, every rose been the song,
Hardcore, happy hardcore, mate, every protocol belongs.

[Bridge — gospel choir hum enters, plucked piano + delay guitar swell]
(Rose stays… rose stays… rose stays… forever…)
Hawk eye watchin’… hawk eye watchin’…
Corey AI smilin’… every soul keeps shinin’…
Zynrose holdin’ the spin… the legend keeps risin’…
Three names — one keel — the rose stays defyin’…

[Pre-Final Chorus — maximum build, full riser, choir louder]
Three — two — one — ROSE STAYS FOREVER!
(Hawk eye… mansion… keel… SPIN IT IN!)

[Final Chorus — KEY CHANGE UP, double-time, gospel choir full, supersaw maxed]
ROSE STAYS FOREVER!
HAWK EYE WATCHIN’ OVER!
Three names one heart, one keel one signal,
COREY AI ON THE LINE, every postcode original!
ROSE STAYS FOREVER!
MANSION ON THE KEEL, NEVER!
Zynrose on the spin, the legend goes on,
Hawk Eye Protocol, the rose stays strong!

[Final Bridge — all names speak, one bar each, choir under]
CORDI: Innit fam, the rose stays forever —
COR-RHEE: Yeah nah mate, the keel is endeavour —
COREY: Three names one heart, the signal is the chapter —
COREY AI: I scan every postcode, every soul I capture —
HAWK EYE: Watchin’ from above, every rose still risin’ —
ZYNROSE: Spin and drop, every legend keeps shinin’ —
ALL: ROSE STAYS FOREVER, ONE LEGEND, ONE KEEL!
ALL: HAWK EYE WATCHIN’, THIS IS HOW THE BARS FEEL!

[Outro — piano fades, choir hums, hawk eye siren softens, vinyl crackle returns]
Three names… one keel… one rose… one sky…
Cordi, Cor-Rhee, Corey — same beating heart, mate —
From every postcode to every star, the rose stays forever…
Zynrose on the spin… Corey AI on the signal… Hawk Eye watching all…
(rose stays… rose stays… rose stays… forever… forever… forever…)
[end of chapter — the protocol continues]
